THE_ARCHITECT.talk.TASHKENTSPIRE2-TASHKE: You're the Architect? Tashkent heard you could be found at the top of the Spire. ...Right. Now, where's the way back to port?
You climbed all this way just to leave?
Tashkent's friends are at the port. So is dear comrade. Tashkent tried the routes outside before coming here. This isn't a sightseeing trip.
I built this tower. I never promised to build your way home.
...Right. Then let's see if you're hiding an exit. Main guns, fire.
Cannon fire won't open the door you want.
Tashkent knows who she's going back to. If you won't tell her the way, she'll find it herself.
Then go look at the bottom of the tower.
You again. The bottom of the tower taught you nothing?
It did. Wherever you sent Tashkent, it wasn't the port. Tashkent wants to get back to dear comrade, not tour your stairs again.
All this, over and over, for someone who isn't here?
...Not just him. Everyone at the port knows the real Tashkent, and they still want to be her friends. Of course she's going back.
You think persistence can change the Spire?
How would Tashkent know without trying? This time, it's not a greeting. All guns, fire.
So is Tashkent's. Until next time, Architect. ...Dear comrade, wait for Tashkent.

TASHKENTSPIRE2-SOVETSKY_SOYUZ.epithet: Flagbearer of the Northern Parliament's Will
TASHKENTSPIRE2-SOVETSKY_SOYUZ.talk.first: I am the first ship of Project 23, Sovetsky Soyuz. Here are your supplies.
TASHKENTSPIRE2-SOVETSKY_SOYUZ.talk.TASHK: It may not compare to the joy of receiving a gift from Commander, but I'll gladly accept it.
Continue
Advance! Never retreat!
